final_message: No — the available tools do not include any capability to query a remote Go module proxy. The toolset is limited to local repository inspection/editing (repo_read, repo_edit, repo_build, repo_find, repo_status), test execution (tests_run, tests_list, tests_focus), Git operations (git_status, git_diff, git_commit), and episode recall. None of these can reach out to an external network service like a Go module proxy.
